name: @guardbee/security-suite
description: All GuardBee MCP security tools in one package — secret scanner, dependency auditor, SSL inspector, DNS intelligence
long_description: Bundles secret scanning, dependency CVE auditing, TLS/SSL inspection, and DNS intelligence into a single combined MCP server. Run `guardbee serve` (this is what the Smithery integration does) to expose all 5 tools at once. No API key required.
